title: Polynomial-time coRP is contained in BPP
statement: Every language of bit strings that has a polynomial-time randomized verifier with polynomially bounded randomness, acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members, and zero acceptance probability on nonmembers also has a polynomial-time randomized verifier whose acceptance and rejection probabilities on members and nonmembers, respectively, are each at least $2/3$.
